description: This file defines an abstract GUI component class for Hono Samplers within a JMeter plugin, providing methods for constructing and customizing the GUI in the context of JMeter's framework.

classes.name: HonoSamplerUI
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating GUI components for Hono samplers in JMeter, providing layout setup and utility methods to add options and manage component alignment.

methods.name: HonoSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI layout, border, title panel, and options panel.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a GUI component to the options panel, positioning it at the bottom.

methods.name: getLabelResource
methods.description: Returns null, probably to be overridden by subclasses for localization.

methods.name: getWrapperPanelToFixAlignment
methods.description: Wraps a JLabeledChoice component in a JPanel to fix alignment issues by adding extra layout and border adjustments.
